clinical_indication: Anterior resection and loop ileostomy for recto-sigmoid junction tumour. A left nephrectomy was performed at the same time for unrelated benign renal disease.

findings.finding_summary: Moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma of the recto-sigmoid colon invading through the bowel wall into the mesocolon, with a separate tumour nodule at the circumferential resection margin, extramural vascular invasion, perineural invasion, and multiple mesocolic tumour deposits.

scores.score_value: C1 (lymph nodes positive but highest node spared)

findings.finding_summary: Additional large tumour deposit within the mesocolon, close to or abutting the circumferential resection margin, separate from the primary tumour mass.
Regional mesocolic lymph nodes, 8 of 14 examined involved by metastatic adenocarcinoma; the highest (apical) node was negative.

specimens.general_features_summary: A small lymphoid aggregate of monomorphic lymphocytes was seen within the mesentery, comprising a mixture of B- and T-cells.

margins.margin_desc: Circumferential: positive (A6); tumour present macroscopically at the posterior circumferential resection margin (R2)

specimens.general_features_summary: Large bowel mucosa with no dysplasia or malignancy.
Large bowel mucosa with no dysplasia or malignancy.
Well-circumscribed fibroadipose nodule containing a benign cyst; no dysplasia or malignancy.

report_summary: Recto-sigmoid resection shows a moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma invading through the bowel wall into the mesocolon, with a separate tumour deposit macroscopically and microscopically involving the circumferential resection margin (R2). Extramural vascular invasion and perineural invasion are present, with multiple additional mesocolic tumour deposits. 8 of 14 lymph nodes are involved, with the highest node negative. Staging: pT3 pN2 pM0, Dukes C1. Longitudinal margin clear; circumferential margin involved. Proximal and distal donuts show normal bowel mucosa with no dysplasia or malignancy. The peritoneal nodule is a benign cyst with no dysplasia or malignancy.
